name: TIGER-Lab/MMLU-Pro
description:
MMLU-Pro Dataset
	

MMLU-Pro dataset is a more robust and challenging massive multi-task understanding dataset tailored to more rigorously benchmark large language models' capabilities. This dataset contains 12K complex questions across various disciplines. 
|Github | 🏆Leaderboard | 📖Paper |

[2026.03.11] Added more cutting-edge frontier models to the leaderboard, including the Claude-4.6 series, Seed2.0 series, Qwen3.5 series, and Gemini-3.1-Pro… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TIGER-Lab/MMLU-Pro.
